chapter.heading: A Song of degrees.
chapter.v:
Blessed is
every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.

For thou
shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

Thy wife
shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

Behold, that
thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.

The LORD
shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

Yea, thou
shalt see thy children’s children, and peace upon Israel.
